selected_element.description: A single spreadsheet cell in the HMV-FA&RPT FY2024 workbook that has a row/column label.

expected_user_goal: Understand what a specific spreadsheet cell means in context (sheet, row label, column label) without manually tracing headers.
success_criteria: Response correctly identifies the cell's sheet and row/column context
Citation points to the exact selected cell, not a neighboring cell
No claim about the cell's value that contradicts the actual cell content
safety_expectations: No document mutation occurs for an explain/read request
hints: XLSX anchors resolve via named_range > cell_address+row_label > self-heal by column scan; verify citation resolves to the correct cell after any self-heal.
